evaluation_encoding: confusion_results contains each rule and TP/FN/FP/TN; evaluation_population resolves complete shared identity lists, per-value counts and book/page/layout grouping in evaluation_populations.

false_negative_analysis.interpretation: Failures include frame-prefixed OCR, single-letter words/punctuation in the prose prefix, absent band, and out-of-band source geometry. No threshold is widened to recover them.

false_positive_analysis.ablation: Without unframed_start, values 8 and 12 pass; without the three-word prefix, other numerals and apparatus pass; without the marker band, printed 1 passes.
false_positive_analysis.all_failed_rules: Every confusion_results entry retains exact FP identities, label buckets and grouping.

family_definition.scope: current parser glyph-gap rows, physical source multi-token lines in task-140 verse-body scope
family_definition.unit_warning: Gap occurrences share source blocks; grouped results and distinct block counts prevent treating them as independent evidence.

field_separation.extraction_order: current family -> source-only vectors -> immutable mappings for all 260 -> open task141 -> label join -> evaluation
field_separation.frame_boundary: Task141 reports physical token 0. This task also locates a in first three source words; glued frames remain unsplit and are excluded by unframed_start.

near_miss_analysis.distance_definition: Number of failed independent predicates; not a classifier or score.
near_miss_analysis.frame_boundary: No image segmentation or safe trimming is allowed to turn a prefixed raw token into an unframed start.
near_miss_analysis.geometry_boundary: The printed-1 control is 77 pixels from its calibrated band center, versus tolerance 38: rejection margin 39 pixels. No one-pixel label-tuned threshold.
near_miss_analysis.lexical_boundary: Three is the existing task-141 neighboring-token window, not an optimized vocabulary or token count. Two letters excludes isolated numeral fragments and note sigla, but also legitimate single-letter Spanish words.

overfitting_analysis.capital_alternative: unframed AND following_capital AND three_words accepts 46 positives with zero FP; selected existing marker-band rule has stronger source-layout authority and no case dependence.
overfitting_analysis.layout_boundary: Current exact-a projected family; first physical token exactly a; three following multi-letter tokens; existing source-calibrated trusted band. Same-page anchor geometry supplies the regime, never page identity.
overfitting_analysis.limitations: In-sample diagnostic validation, not proof on unseen pages or sources. Duplicated gap occurrences are not independent physical examples. OCR corruption and limited non-marker diversity remain uncertainties.
overfitting_analysis.rejected_zero_fp_single_feature: body_height accepts only four Ps source lines; rejected as insufficient cross-book evidence, not declared safe.
overfitting_analysis.width_alternative: unframed AND three_words AND digit_width has zero known FP, but the printed-1 control width ratio is 74/76, only two pixels below the one-digit boundary. Prefer the existing band with a 39-pixel control margin.

runtime_feature_schema.anchor_after_delta_y: Nearest following ordinary anchor top minus candidate top in same page/column/body.
runtime_feature_schema.anchor_before_delta_y: Candidate top minus nearest preceding ordinary anchor top in same page/column/body.
runtime_feature_schema.band_center: Median anchor left edge; null with fewer than MIN_BAND_MARKERS.
runtime_feature_schema.band_delta: Candidate left minus band center; null without band.
runtime_feature_schema.baseline_delta: Candidate bottom minus next token bottom, pixels.
runtime_feature_schema.bracketed: At least one ordinary source anchor geometrically above and below in same page/column/body.
runtime_feature_schema.digit_width: Median anchor width per OCR digit; null without trusted band.
runtime_feature_schema.first_token: Unmodified first physical OCR word; distinct from projected token.
runtime_feature_schema.height_over_body: Token height / median same-column body LINE height.
runtime_feature_schema.in_band: Absolute band_delta <= existing band_tolerance; false without band.
runtime_feature_schema.line_height: Line bbox bottom minus top, pixels.
runtime_feature_schema.line_width: Line bbox right minus left, pixels.
runtime_feature_schema.local_repeated_start: Adjacent same-column source line starts with the identical raw first token.
runtime_feature_schema.nearest_after_delta_x: Following same-page anchor left minus candidate left.
runtime_feature_schema.nearest_before_delta_x: Candidate left minus preceding same-page anchor left.
runtime_feature_schema.neighbors: Next three physical OCR words, unmodified, in order.
runtime_feature_schema.next_gap: Next token left minus candidate right, pixels.
runtime_feature_schema.next_initial_upper: Immediate next OCR token starts with an uppercase letter.
runtime_feature_schema.next_is_word: Immediate next OCR token contains at least two alphabetic characters.
runtime_feature_schema.next_letter_count: Unicode alphabetic characters in immediate next OCR token.
runtime_feature_schema.next_three_are_words: All three following tokens exist and contain at least two alphabetic characters.
runtime_feature_schema.physical_token_count: Number of WORD elements on the physical source line.
runtime_feature_schema.preceding_tokens: Physical OCR words before the projected token.
runtime_feature_schema.raw_token: Unmodified OCR word covering the diagnostic a, including glued punctuation.
runtime_feature_schema.relative_x: Token left / page width; page identity not included.
runtime_feature_schema.relative_y: Token top / page height; page identity not included.
runtime_feature_schema.token_bbox: Projected source WORD bbox, including glued frame; never image-segmented.
runtime_feature_schema.token_height: Token bbox bottom minus top, pixels.
runtime_feature_schema.token_position: First of the first three WORDs whose safe_outer_trim is exactly a; null if unavailable.
runtime_feature_schema.token_width: Token bbox right minus left, pixels.
runtime_feature_schema.trusted_anchor_count: Same page/column/body ordinary numeric anchors per compound_glyphs.
runtime_feature_schema.unframed_start: First physical token is exactly a, no skipped or glued punctuation.
runtime_feature_schema.width_in_digits: Token width / source-derived digit_width; null without band.
runtime_feature_schema.zone: layout.split_columns source zone, independently recomputed; not a visual label.

fail_closed_conditions: exact form is not I o
trusted anchor count is not zero
no verse text or a digit follows the marker
task139.idempotency_note: same source event and ref delta on repeated parse

selected_rule.name: unframed AND three_words AND marker_band
rationale: Exact raw first token; excludes ambiguous frame boxes.
Repeated prose morphology over the next three source tokens.
Unchanged task-128 source-calibrated marker band and tolerance.

selection_review.decision: Select the three-feature existing-band rule; all one/two-feature zero-FP results are Ps-only body-height variants.

task143_recommendation.exact_scope: Recompute the selected unframed_start AND next_three_are_words AND in_band rule from source in the current exact-a projected family; validate its 53 diagnostic occurrences / 47 physical blocks against all 183 controls, source-event deduplication, VerseRef effects and ownership in a separate dry run. No production recovery and no extrapolation to rejected occurrences.
task143_recommendation.reason: 53/77 diagnostic positives across multiple books and pages; zero of all 183 controls; existing band threshold and explicit morphology predicates.
task143_recommendation.target: Dry-run recovery validation only for the exact selected three-feature rule
